title: KU students travel to Algeria for international goodwill visit
summary_en: Six University of Kansas School of Music students recently joined city of Lawrence officials for a six-day trip to Algeria, where they took part in an international goodwill visit recognizing the relationship between Lawrence and the North African country.
title_cn: KU students travel to Algeria for international goodwill visit

title: Witnessing generosity from low-income donors more likely to elicit giving from observers, research finds
summary_en: In a new research article, Yexin Jessica Li, Ned N. Fleming Professor of Consumer Psychology at the University of Kansas School of Business, shows how identical acts of giving inspire different levels of moral elevation and downstream generosity depending on who gives.
title_cn: Witnessing generosity from low-income donors more likely to elicit giving from observers, research finds

title: KC-135 tanker to fly over KU Lawrence campus before Saturday football game
summary_en: A KC-135 Stratotanker will fly over the University of Kansas Lawrence campus Saturday, Nov. 21, shortly before kickoff of the 11 a.m. football game between KU and Brigham Young University.
title_cn: KC-135 tanker to fly over KU Lawrence campus before Saturday football game
